[P2] Establish regression evidence before implementing the fix

Rule 5, “A bug fix starts with a failing test,” is unmet: the description acknowledges that implementation and tests share one commit and supplies no before-fix test result. This test calls a helper absent from the base revision, so its baseline failure would demonstrate a missing helper rather than reproduce the hard-coded Jest invocation. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and agree on regression evidence that demonstrates the original failure before the fix.
